what_happened: Scene: layout 10 (same kitchen as s15, s29), brown steel pot (Pot075) on the rear-right zone of an electric hob, potato and sweet potato on the counter right of the hob, spatula_7 (wooden handle, metal blade) on the counter. Stage 0: potato grasped 105, dropped in 138 (complete 140, fastest). Stage 1 was slow (616 steps, median 282, p90 551): the first close on the flat sweet potato at 211 did not lift it (width 0.014), and the gripper then stayed CLOSED (0.001) from 240 to ~585 while the arm hovered back and forth between the counter and the pot empty-handed (wrist 260-540: the pot with the potato, the sweet potato still on the counter). The fingers reopened ~592, re-grasped the sweet potato 660, dropped it in 755 (complete 756). Stage 2: spatula grasped 858 at the end of the wooden handle, lifted (complete 875). Stage 3 (~100 steps): 900-940 the blade was brought over the pot's right rim and pushed down into the pot among the vegetables (944-976); the online log recorded stage 3 at 976 (success).
self_recovery: Recovered from the missed sweet-potato grasp at 211 after ~380 steps of closed-gripper hovering (re-opened 592, re-grasp 660). This cost ~330 steps over the median but the rest was fast.
official_criterion_notes: Replay disagrees with the online log for stage 3 (replay success_time 4 at the end, online success at 976) - the known counter-replay issue; trust the online log.
